title: Our work
heading: Faith in everyday life. Support that connects.
intro: Eight areas of work form the outline of our ministry. Specific programmes and arrangements will be added with the leadership.

evangelisation.title: Evangelism
evangelisation.body: Sharing the Christian faith and making space for conversations and questions. Details of specific activities will follow.

fluechtlingsarbeit.title: Refugee outreach
fluechtlingsarbeit.body: Meeting and accompanying people with experiences of displacement. Specific support options will be added.

camp-besuche.title: Visits to refugee camps
camp-besuche.body: Visits, personal encounters and practical help on site are among the planned areas of work. Locations and dates will follow after confirmation.

praktische-hilfe.title: Practical help
praktische-hilfe.body: Support in everyday life and with specific needs. Available forms of assistance will be added here.

sprachkurse.title: Language courses
sprachkurse.body: Language helps people communicate and participate. Course details, languages and registration options will follow.

juengerschaft.title: Discipleship
juengerschaft.body: Understanding the Christian faith together and living it in everyday life. Information about groups and guidance will follow.

gemeinschaft.title: Leisure & community
gemeinschaft.body: Spending time together, building relationships and experiencing community. Current activities will be added.

camps.title: Camps / events
camps.body: Information about camps, community days and events. Confirmed dates and registration details will be available under News.
